name: How do I choose the right contractor for home restoration and repairs?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for home restoration and repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: When hiring a contractor for restoration work, look for a licensed, insured general contractor with documented experience in both structural repair and detailed finish trades. Restoration often uncovers hidden issues behind walls, so your contractor must be skilled in custom framing, subfloor stabilization, and drywall patching, while also managing plumbing and electrical trades. Check verified credentials, such as an A+ rating with the Better Business Bureau, and verify that the lead contractor will be directly accessible on-site rather than delegating your home to rotating sub-crews. Clear communication regarding trade coordination and daily project management is critical for staying on schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose an experienced general contractor who handles structural framing and finish trades directly, holds strong BBB standing, and provides clear on-site project management.
